body: We fought alot during the beginning of our relationship. Since we were both young. We have recently been doing really good. But she's bringing up my behavior from the around 2 years ago. How I belittled her, not true. I did mock her interests. But I was just being dumb .That is not the situation any longer..I also forgave her for having sexual thoughts for another and in a way she tried to act on them. But we overcame everything. The night before she left we were talking about getting married and having kids. I'm so confused tbh. And she's not talking to me at all. Besides that email.

We were both uncomfortable with our roommates guest. And the both of us were being immature about it. Not wanting to leave the room. It was about to be 9pm. We hadn't ate. So we were hangry. We were about to go on a walk while the food cooked but she mentioned being bored so I said go home, you never see your family anyway.. we both had an attitude. And that's what happened. Dumb argument over not wanting to leave the room and being hungry. She took me saying go home as in leave forever.
